rows.label: Study notes
rows.text: **Superficial expansion.** A heated sheet grows in area as ΔA = A₀βt where β is the areal expansion coefficient; for isotropic solids β = 2α, α being the linear coefficient.  ·  **Cubical expansion.** A heated solid grows in volume as ΔV = V₀γt with γ = 3α — the cube relation follows because V = L³, so ΔV/V = 3ΔL/L.  ·  **Derivation.** From V = L³, differentiating gives dV/V = 3 dL/L; similarly dA/A = 2 dL/L — hence β : γ = 2 : 3 relative to α.
